name: 8GB VRAM: Llama 3.1 8B Q4_K_M decode tokens/sec
methodology: llama.cpp CUDA backend, batch size 1, 512 token prompt, 128 token output, Q4_K_M quantization, 8GB VRAM (e.g., RTX 3060 8GB, RTX 4060 8GB)
notes: 8GB VRAM is the minimum for local LLM inference. An 8B model at Q4_K_M requires ~5GB of VRAM, fitting with room for short context. A 13B model at Q4_K_M requires ~8GB, which barely fits with no room for KV cache. 8GB is suitable for 7B models at 4-bit or smaller models at 8-bit.
